notes: *nought* is read as one fusion of לֹא and מְאוּמָה under rule 35, headed on the negative and discontinuous under rule 25; the alternative gives *nought* to מְאוּמָה alone and marks the negative unrepresented, which rule 35's *no* case rules out.

רִחַם → *have compassion upon* is headed on the complement under rule 44, the supplied *upon* being the preposition the English verb needs to reach its object, no preposition morpheme standing in the Hebrew.
חֵרֶם → *devoted thing* is headed on *devoted*, *thing* being the supplied generic (rule 31).
